prior_information: A separate exploratory audit already examined the saved data and these influence diagnostics. This protocol freezes their portable production specification; it is not prospective outcome-blind preregistration.
primary_preserved: The existing equal-episode mean of within-call AUC_Q minus AUC_stabilized_L2 differences and the existing paired-call median remain unchanged. No primary point, interval, exclusion, or frozen source artifact is replaced.
single_episode_omissions: For all eight cases, omit every recorded episode once, retain all calls in every other episode, and recompute the equal-episode mean. Report all 240 omitted identities, their physical record IDs, retained-population hashes, remaining means, extrema, and exact sign agreement with the full mean. Zero is a separate sign.

negative_mass.call_denominator: Sum of absolute negative paired call differences within one case, excluding zero and positive terms.
negative_mass.episode_denominator: Sum of absolute negative within-episode mean differences within one case, excluding zero and positive terms. This is not the signed net mean or raw call total.
negative_mass.concentration: Largest negative episode-mean magnitude divided by negative episode-mean mass; top 1, 3, 5 and 10 negative call magnitudes divided by negative call mass. Ties use physical record ID or episode ID. No negative mass gives a null share.

tail_examples: For every case select the minimum paired call difference, breaking ties by physical record ID. Retain physical and episode identities, both AUCs, native endpoints, both normalization gaps, actual/baseline/saved squared residuals, maximum residual, maximum-to-baseline ratio when baseline is positive, and weak empirical percentiles 100*count(value<=example)/n within the same case for baseline and per-call maximum residual.
authentication: Authenticate the frozen paired provenance anchor, every declared paired artifact and source/protocol hash, canonical provenance/code/outputs, original input manifest/raw bytes and selected physical records. Check all saved call identities, episode memberships, values and full summary points before deriving influence results.
scope_limits: Exploratory deterministic influence diagnostics, not new confidence intervals, p-values, coverage calibration or population inference.
No trimming, outcome-dependent primary exclusions, changed eligibility threshold or replacement estimand.
No cross-ranking-arm join or authentication, even when nominal episode/call labels match.
Recorded episodes are grouping labels, not authenticated independent experimental units or training replications.
Finite saved ordinates do not identify unobserved continuous interventions, realized masks, physical action importance, ranking efficacy or task success.
No model inference, simulator, GPU, new experimental sample or paid operation.
